item.title: Overflowing a JNI Buffer to Hijack system() in an Android Native Library
item.description: Exploiting a native stack buffer overflow in Note Keeper's JNI code to overwrite a command buffer adjacent to the overflow target, achieving arbitrary command execution via system().
